title: Differentiating PC12 Cells to Evaluate Neurite Densities through Live-Cell Imaging
author: Karliner, Merry

steps.title: Prepare supplemented half‑feed medium
steps.instruction: Calculate the volumes of stock differentiation medium, NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX needed for a half‑feed of 75 µL per well (plus three extra wells). Aliquot the required amount of stock differentiation medium, pre‑warm to 37 °C, and add the calculated volumes of NGF (to obtain a working concentration of 100 ng/mL in the supplement, giving a final 50 ng/mL after feeding), CultureOne (to obtain a 1:25 working dilution, giving a final 1:50 dilution in the well), and GlutaMAX (to maintain 4 mM, which is already present in the stock). Pipette up and down a few times to mix. Perform all steps under sterile conditions in a tissue‑culture hood; add AraC if excessive proliferation or clumping is observed.

substeps.instruction: a. Calculate total volume of stock differentiation medium for 75 µL per well + 3 extra wells; aliquot and pre‑warm to 37 °C.
b. Calculate NGF stock volume to reach 100 ng/mL in the prepared supplement (final well concentration 50 ng/mL).
c. Calculate CultureOne volume for a 1:25 working dilution (final well dilution 1:50).
d. Calculate GlutaMAX volume for a 4 mM working concentration (final well concentration remains 4 mM).
e. Remove the calculated volumes of NGF, CultureOne, and GlutaMAX from the pre‑warmed aliquot and add them; mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Half‑feed media change (96‑well)
steps.instruction: Every two days, remove and discard 75 µL of media from each well of the 96‑well plate, then add 75 µL of the pre‑warmed, supplemented medium prepared in the previous step. Repeat this half‑feed every 2 days until the total neurite density reaches approximately 1,500 µm/mm².

steps.title: Daily microscopic observation
steps.instruction: Observe differentiating PC12 cells under an inverted light microscope each day to verify expected neurite outgrowth and overall health.

steps.title: Plate cells for western blot
steps.instruction: Coat 6‑well plates with poly‑D‑lysine (PDL). Seed PC12 cells at the appropriate density for differentiation and incubate under standard culture conditions.

steps.title: Collect lysates for western blot
steps.instruction: On Day 0 and every subsequent 2 days (or daily if needed) until neurite density reaches ~1,500 µm/mm², harvest cells from designated wells, prepare protein lysates, and store for western‑blot analysis of neuronal markers.

steps.title: Maintain 6‑well cultures with half‑feed
steps.instruction: Every two days (excluding wells scheduled for lysate collection), prepare supplemented differentiation medium as in Step 1 but for a final volume of 1 mL per well. Remove and discard 1 mL of media from each well and add 1 mL of the supplemented medium. Re‑calculate reagent volumes each cycle to avoid waste.

steps.title: Daily observation of 6‑well cultures
steps.instruction: Observe the differentiating PC12 cells in the 6‑well plates under an inverted light microscope each day to ensure proper differentiation.
